description: Inmaculada Rodríguez-Martín publishes randomly generated capacitated vehicle-routing instances through the University of La Laguna repository on Mendeley Data. The source specifies TSPLIB format, node coordinates within a synthetic square from 0 to 100 on each axis, demands from 1 to 25 and vehicle capacity Q equal to 100. These inputs support optimisation experiments for capacitated freight vehicle routing. Spatial coverage is synthetic: coordinates are benchmark coordinates, not a stated geographic coordinate system, and the data do not describe actual customer locations or observed deliveries. The current public version 2 was published on 11 June 2026, following version 1 in October 2023. Repository metadata lists individual VRP files and grants CC BY 4.0 reuse with free public access. Files were not downloaded or executed. The generator distribution, physical units, depot conventions, full internal schema and any sampling time remain unstated in the public description. The lack of these details limits reproduction of the instance-generation process. Update frequency is not stated. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
